text:
Introduction
This document outlines the first level of inspection I1, to be performed 
on an annually bases Y1 as indicated in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
Eng. Ayman Mahmoud Awad, tested at 17 April 2002 by eng Emad Farouq Mostafa at Katamia Substation, Cairo
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Ensure that the CB isolated completely and proper 
 grounded on both sides,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety 
 Helmet.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Ensure that the CB isolated completely and proper 
 grounded on both sides,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety 
 Helmet.
Isolate the DC
 control voltage, the door of the local CB must be opened.
Tools and Equipment
1 set of fitter's tools, 1 
 torque wrench, 
 and some of clean and dry cloth,
1 industrial vacuum cleaner, 
 special tools, and lifting gear (fork lift).
Exhaust tube - operating rod, 1 
 socket spanner - locking tool
Works to be Carried Out
Drain off condensate water.
Check with drow 
 system and interlock.
Check plugs.
Remove packing ring if necessary.
Check density monitor.
Retignten loose screws.
Clean porcelain insulator and remove dust.
Check air manometer.
